verdict.rationale: Authy is a 2FA authenticator app with a now-deprecated verification API, and it has no automation or workflow layer. Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is therefore the wrong axis for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships automations, and backup and sync of 2FA tokens is not versioning or rollback of automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
